title: QA Pilot RCR Closeout Gate
description: Schema for QA Pilot RCR closeout gate packets. Every completed sprint must declare its registry impact and provide a valid RCR receipt (or no_registry_impact rationale) before it can be considered seal-ready. Advisory-only, QA Pilot-local.

sprint_id.description: The sprint ID being closed out.

ledger_number.description: Ledger number of the sprint being closed out.

registry_impact.description: Declared registry impact for this sprint.

rcr_receipt_id.description: RCR receipt ID for sprints that affect the registry. Required when registry_impact is adds_layer/updates_layer/deprecates_layer.

registry_before_summary.description: Registry state summary before this sprint.

registry_after_summary.description: Registry state summary after this sprint.

no_impact_rationale.description: Rationale for no_registry_impact classification. Required and >= 20 chars when registry_impact=no_registry_impact.

closeout_status.description: Closeout gate status: ready=all checks pass, blocked=missing critical requirements, degraded=non-critical issues.

allOf.description: If registry_impact is not no_registry_impact, RCR receipt required.
If registry_impact is no_registry_impact, rationale required with minLength 20.
